jobs.title: Hindi Language Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
jobs.content: <p>We are seeking Hindi specialists to test AI models on grammar, idioms, regional dialects and formal versus informal speech, documenting errors clearly.</p><ul><li>Native-level Hindi and fluent English</li><li>Master's or PhD in Hindi or linguistics is ideal</li><li>Clear written reasoning</li></ul><p>Pay: $6–$65 per hour. Contract, remote.</p>
